src/flyquery/core/agents/builder.py.rationale: The current canon factory preserves Azure model resolution and has different settings. flyquery retains its own model factory and adds the tested instruction-only prompt-cache policy; full-file parity with canon is not asserted.

src/flyquery/core/observability/__init__.rationale: Canon at the referenced release has no generic core/observability module. flyquery owns its per-construction FLYQUERY_PROMPT_CACHE switch, adds no user/tool cache flags or shared OpenAI routing key, and relies on Agentic logging/observability defaults.
